---
title: "Heterogeneous Kuramoto Oscillators"
subtitle: "Phase oscillators with heterogeneous frequencies on a ring network"
---

Replicates the [NetworkDynamics.jl Heterogeneous System tutorial](https://juliadynamics.github.io/NetworkDynamics.jl/stable/generated/heterogeneous_system/) — Kuramoto phase oscillators on an 8-node ring with heterogeneous natural frequencies.

## YAML Specification

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import Code, Markdown
Code(filename="yaml/kuramoto.yaml", language="yaml")
```

## Model Report

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("yaml/kuramoto.yaml")
Markdown(exp.generate_report())
```

## Generated Julia Code

```{python}
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("yaml/kuramoto.yaml")
Code(exp.render_code("networkdynamics"), language='julia')
```

## Run & Plot

```{python}
ts = exp.run(format="networkdynamics")
ts.plot()
```

## Results

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
print(f"Shape: {ts.data.shape}")
print(f"Time range: {ts.time[0]:.1f} – {ts.time[-1]:.1f}")
print(f"Final theta range: [{ts.data[-1, 0, :, 0].min():.3f}, {ts.data[-1, 0, :, 0].max():.3f}]")
```

## Animate

```{python}
ani = ts.animate("theta", format="dots")
ani.save("kuramoto.gif", writer="pillow", fps=20)
```
